MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The memory card and reader bundle fits my repeated purchases of storage cards and transfer accessories, provided the card format works with my devices.",
    "The Fire TV Stick feels useful because it could add streaming to my television, provided I confirm a suitable HDMI input."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Echo displays, speaker, and car assistant introduce uses I have not been seeking; my accessories usually solve a specific storage, mounting, or connection need.",
    "Buying camera tripods and a lens cap does not mean I need a home monitoring camera, and buying surge protectors does not mean I want voice-controlled outlets.",
    "The USB-C cables and desktop memory require specific compatible hardware and a current need that my purchases do not establish."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Owning a Fire tablet seems to have been treated as interest in many other Amazon devices, although those products serve different purposes.",
    "Broad similarities such as cables, cameras, and power accessories seem to matter more than the particular task each purchase helped me accomplish."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated memory card, reader, and card-storage purchases show an ongoing interest in storing, transferring, and organizing files.",
    "Connector type, card format, and device fit matter to me; an accessory is useful only when it works with the equipment I have.",
    "I frequently buy practical additions for existing equipment, which gives me more reason to consider a useful accessory than an unrelated new device."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my storage and television needs but stretched my practical accessory purchases into unsupported interest in Alexa devices and unrelated hardware."
}
